notes.title: Polybius Invaders 2 Demo Live Stream
notes.content:
Get to ask me questions about  anything you may want to know, as I demo my game "Polybius Invaders 2".
It's a super scaler game with pinball-esque scoring mechanics, giving you an arcade experience, of when games were great.
